stories.title: Apple unveils foldable iPhone Duo alongside iPhone 18 Pro in first launch under new CEO John Ternus
stories.reason: It's the biggest change to the iPhone lineup since 2007 and the first product event of the post-Tim Cook era, with Apple finally entering the foldable category Samsung has dominated for years.

stories.title: Investigation finds Meta ran hundreds of ads containing AI-generated child sexual abuse material
stories.reason: Tech Transparency Project found 332 ads exploiting real children's photos slipped through Meta's review process between November 2025 and August 2026, with new ones still appearing after Meta touted improved detection systems.

stories.title: Metropolitan Police open criminal investigation into Reform UK over alleged foreign funding scheme
stories.reason: A Channel 4 undercover sting caught senior Reform aides arranging for a purported American donor to secretly bankroll party polling, prompting two resignations and a probe that will be merged with an existing Met inquiry into the party's donations.

stories.title: Russian drone strike on Sumy shopping center kills 2, injures 20 including children
stories.reason: The strike hit the Manufaktura mall as crowds shopped after work, a day after a separate Russian attack on a passenger train in the same region killed two more civilians, underscoring the war's continued toll on civilians far from the front line.

stories.title: Eurozone inflation jumps to 3.3% in August as energy prices surge on Iran war fallout
stories.reason: Energy costs rose 14.3% year-on-year as Strait of Hormuz disruptions push oil and gas prices higher, pushing headline inflation well above the ECB's 2% target and complicating its policy path.

stories.title: Global bond selloff deepens as 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since January 2025
stories.reason: Rising oil prices, a $2 trillion US deficit and heavy corporate debt issuance are driving borrowing costs to multiyear highs from Washington to Tokyo to London, raising the stakes for next week's Fed decision.

stories.title: Google commits $15 billion to Finnish AI data centers, secures 22-year nuclear power deal
stories.reason: The agreement extends the life of the Loviisa nuclear plant to 2050 and marks Google's first nuclear energy deal outside the US, showing how AI's power demands are reshaping national energy planning.

stories.title: Qualcomm shares jump 10% after Amazon signs it for custom AI inference chips in deal worth up to $60 billion
stories.reason: The multi-year, multi-generation partnership positions Qualcomm as a new challenger to Nvidia in data-center AI silicon and gives Amazon a second custom-chip supplier beyond its in-house Trainium line.
